name: mgh-ed-hiring
description: MGH ED physician hiring: screen, schedule, panel, score and rank (GitHub Pages + Firebase)

paragraphs: A five-stage hiring tool: Screen → Availability → Panels → Score → Ranking. Static frontend (no build step). Runs in local mode out of the box; add a Firebase project to go multi-device and real-time.
the Guest password, then your name and your times.

The clickable prototype Kyle reviewed (mock.html) was deleted on Sept 21 2026, once the real tool had superseded it. It was still being served publicly, it looked enough like the real thing to confuse anyone handed the wrong link, and it carried a second copy of the encrypted questions — so re-keying had to be done in two places or the stale copy would still open under the old code.

whatItDoes.text: A five-stage hiring tool: Screen → Availability → Panels → Score → Ranking. Static frontend (no build step). Runs in local mode out of the box; add a Firebase project to go multi-device and real-time.

requirements.text: The sign-in page finds your role by which account accepts the password (ED first, then Guest, then Leadership; the role that last worked on this browser first; Guest first on an applicant link).
The password itself is never saved: a reload in the same tab resumes from Firebase's own sign-in for that tab.
